{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Water Snake''' (癸巳, ''mizunoto mi''; onyomi ''kishi'') is the 30th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 30th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Wood Horse|ja|甲午}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''癸'' is Yin Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Water Snake (癸巳)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): guǐsì
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gwai2 si6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoto-mi
*** On'yomi: kishi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gisa (계사)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Quý Tỵ

==Months of Yin Water Snake==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the Heavenly Stem is {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin}} or {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the month of {{ill|April|en|April|qid=Q118|lt=April}} is considered the Mizunotomi {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}}. However, the month referred to here may also be based on the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or on the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}} to the day before {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Bōshu}}).

==Days of Yin Water Snake==
The selection of auspicious days for Mizunotomi is as follows.
===Selected Day===
The Mizunotomi day is the 10th (final) day of {{ill|Ten directions|ja|十方暮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten Directions|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11405067}} and the 1st day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tian Yi Tianshang|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
